 // Only compute delta1 if batch wasn't voided during price computation\n        if (batch.state != BatchState.OPEN) { \n            _computeDelta1(currentBatchId);\n            batch.state = function startSettling() external {\n        Batch storage batch = batches[currentBatchId];\n        require(batch.state == BatchState.DISPUTING, \"Not in DISPUTING state\");\n        require(block.number >= batch.disputeEnd, \"DISPUTING phase not ended\");\n\n        // Normalize to quote units before ratioing: buyVolume is quote(6-dec), sellVolume is\n        // base(18-dec). Without this the 18-dec base term\n        // dominates and disputeRatio collapses to ~0, defeating the void circuit-breaker.\n        uint256 price = batch.settlementPrice;\n        uint256 totalVolume = batch.buyVolume + _baseToQuote(batch.sellVolume, price);\n        uint256 buyDisp = batch.buyDisputedVolume;\n        uint256 sellDispQuote = _baseToQuote(batch.sellDisputedVolume, price);\n        uint256 maxDisputedVolume = buyDisp > sellDispQuote ? buyDisp : sellDispQuote;\n\n        uint256 disputeRatio = totalVolume == 0 ? 0 : (maxDisputedVolume * 100) / totalVolume;\n\n        if (disputeRatio > DISPUTE_VOID_THRESHOLD) {\n            _voidBatch(currentBatchId, \"Dispute threshold exceeded\");\n            return;\n        }\n\n        _computeDelta2(currentBatchId, disputeRatio);\n\n        batch.state = BatchState.SETTLING;\n        batch.settlingEnd = block.number + SETTLING_DURATION;\n\n        emit BatchStateChanged(currentBatchId, BatchState.SETTLING, batch.settlingEnd);\n    }\n\n    function executeSettlement() external {\n        Batch storage batch = batches[currentBatchId];\n        require(batch.state == BatchState.SETTLING, \"Not in SETTLING state\");\n        require(block.number >= batch.settlingEnd, \"SETTLING phase not ended\");\n\n        _updateOracleWeights(currentBatchId);\n\n        // Fill ratios are computed from NET (non-disputed) volumes so they stay consistent with\n        // the amounts actually paid out in claim(). Disputed volume is fully refunded and never\n        // matched, so it must be excluded here too.\n        uint256 netBuy = batch.buyVolume - batch.buyDisputedVolume;\n        uint256 netSell = batch.sellVolume - batch.sellDisputedVolume;\n        uint256 sellVolumeInQuote = _baseToQuote(netSell, batch.settlementPrice);\n        uint256 buyFillRatio  = _calculateFillRatio(netBuy, sellVolumeInQuote, true);\n        uint256 sellFillRatio = _calculateFillRatio(netBuy, sellVolumeInQuote, false);\n\n        lastSettlementPrice = batch.settlementPrice;\n\n        emit BatchSettled(currentBatchId, batch.settlementPrice, buyFillRatio, sellFillRatio);\n\n        _createBatch(batch.asset);\n    }\n\n    // ===== 1inch AQUA ROUTING (uncrossed remainder) =====\n\n    /// @notice Set the 1inch Aqua router adapter (see AquaRouter.sol). Owner-only.\n    function setAquaRouter(address _router) external onlyOwner {\n        aquaRouter = _router;\n        emit AquaRouterSet(_router);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Route a settled batch's uncrossed (over-supplied) remainder to 1inch Aqua/SwapVM so\n    ///         that side is filled at market instead of merely refunded its deposit. Callable once\n    ///         per settled batch by the Solver Agent, which supplies Aqua-SDK calldata + a minOut\n    ///         slippage floor built from a live Aqua quote.\n    /// @dev Only the uncrossed remainder (larger side minus the matched amount) is swapped; the\n    ///      matched leg and disputed refunds are untouched. The received counter-asset is escrowed\n    ///      in `batch.aquaOut` and paid pro-rata to the uncrossed side in claim() \u2014 preserving the\n    ///      contract's provable per-pull solvency (floors sum to <= aquaOut).\n    function routeUncrossedToAqua(uint256 _batchId, uint256 _minOut, bytes calldata _aquaCalldata) external nonReentrant {\n        require(aquaRouter != address(0), \"Aqua router unset\");\n        Batch storage batch = batches[_batchId];\n        require(batch.settlementPrice > 0, \"Batch not settled\");\n        AquaFill storage fill = aquaFills[_batchId];\n        require(!fill.routed, \"Already routed\");\n\n        (bool sideBuy, uint256 amountIn) = _uncrossedRemainder(batch);\n        require(amountIn > 0, \"No uncrossed volume\");\n\n        fill.routed = true; // effects before interaction\n        fill.sideBuy = sideBuy;\n\n        // Buy side over-supplied quote -> swap QUOTE->BASE; sell side -> swap BASE->QUOTE.\n        (address tokenIn, address tokenOut) = sideBuy ? (quoteAsset, baseAsset) : (baseAsset, quoteAsset);\n        uint256 out = _routeViaAqua(tokenIn, tokenOut, amountIn, _minOut, _aquaCalldata);\n        fill.out = out;\n        emit UncrossedRouted(_batchId, sideBuy, amountIn, out);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The uncrossed (over-supplied) side of a settled batch and its remainder amount, so the\n    ///         Solver Agent can fetch an Aqua quote for it before calling routeUncrossedToAqua.\n    /// @return sideBuy  true if the buy side is over-supplied (remainder is QUOTE), else SELL (BASE).\n    /// @return amountIn the uncrossed remainder in that side's deposit asset (0 if fully crossed).\n    function getUncrossedRemainder(uint256 _batchId) external view returns (bool sideBuy, uint256 amountIn) {\n        return _uncrossedRemainder(batches[_batchId]);\n    }\n\n    // Compute the uncrossed (over-supplied) side of a settled batch and its remainder amount (in the\n    // deposit asset of that side): buy side -> leftover QUOTE, sell side -> leftover BASE.\n    function _uncrossedRemainder(Batch storage batch) internal view returns (bool sideBuy, uint256 amountIn) {\n        uint256 netBuy = batch.buyVolume - batch.buyDisputedVolume;    // quote units\n        uint256 netSell = batch.sellVolume - batch.sellDisputedVolume; // base units\n        uint256 sellVolumeInQuote = _baseToQuote(netSell, batch.settlementPrice);\n        uint256 matchedQuote = netBuy < sellVolumeInQuote ? netBuy : sellVolumeInQuote;\n        if (netBuy > matchedQuote) return (true, netBuy - matchedQuote);\n        uint256 matchedBase = _quoteToBase(matchedQuote, batch.settlementPrice);\n        if (netSell > matchedBase) return (false, netSell - matchedBase);\n        return (false, 0);\n    }\n\n    function _routeViaAqua(\n        address tokenIn,\n        address tokenOut,\n        uint256 amountIn,\n        uint256 minOut,\n        bytes calldata data\n    ) internal returns (uint256) {\n        IERC20(tokenIn).forceApprove(aquaRouter, amountIn);\n        uint256 balBefore = IERC20(tokenOut).balanceOf(address(this));\n        IAquaRouter(aquaRouter).routeExactIn(tokenIn, tokenOut, amountIn, minOut, data);\n        uint256 delta = IERC20(tokenOut).balanceOf(address(this)) - balBefore;\n        require(delta >= minOut, \"Aqua underfilled\");\n        IERC20(tokenIn).forceApprove(aquaRouter, 0); // clear residual allowance\n        return delta;\n    }\n\n    function _voidBatch(uint256 _batchId, string memory _reason) internal {\n        Batch storage batch = batches[_batchId];\n        batch.state = BatchState.OPEN; // Reuse OPEN as VOIDED state\n        emit BatchVoided(_batchId, _reason);\n        _createBatch(batch.asset);\n    }\n\n    // ===== CLAIMING =====\n\n    function claim(uint256 _batchId) external nonReentrant {\n        Batch storage batch = batches[_batchId];\n        UserOrder storage order = batch.orders[msg.sender];\n\n        require(order.amount > 0, \"No order\");\n        require(!order.claimed, \"Already claimed\");\n        order.claimed = true;\n\n        // Voided (state reset to OPEN) or disputed -> full refund in the DEPOSITED asset\n        if (order.disputed || batch.state == BatchState.OPEN) {\n            address inTok = order.side == Side.BUY ? quoteAsset : baseAsset;\n            IERC20(inTok).safeTransfer(msg.sender, order.amount);\n            emit Claimed(_batchId, msg.sender, 0, order.amount);\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Provably-solvent per-pull pro-rata payout over NET (non-disputed) volume only.\n        // Disputed orders already took the full-refund early-return above; their deposits are\n        // reserved for that refund and MUST NOT be matched. Matching against gross volume would\n        // pay a fill against volume that was also refunded, draining the pool short.\n        // Each non-disputed user pulls floor(their_deposit / net_side_volume * aggregate); the\n        // per-user floors sum to <= the aggregate, matchedBase <= netSell and matchedQuote <= netBuy\n        // by construction, so no claim reverts for insolvency (rounding dust stays in the contract).\n        uint256 netBuy = batch.buyVolume - batch.buyDisputedVolume;    // quote units\n        uint256 netSell = batch.sellVolume - batch.sellDisputedVolume; // base units\n        uint256 matchedQuote;\n        {\n            uint256 sellVolumeInQuote = _baseToQuote(netSell, batch.settlementPrice);\n            matchedQuote = netBuy < sellVolumeInQuote ? netBuy : sellVolumeInQuote; // min\n        }\n        uint256 matchedBase = _quoteToBase(matchedQuote, batch.settlementPrice);\n\n        if (order.side == Side.BUY) {\n            _claimBuy(_batchId, order.amount, netBuy, matchedQuote, matchedBase);\n        } else {\n            _claimSell(_batchId, order.amount, netSell, matchedQuote, matchedBase);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // buyer deposited `amount` in QUOTE; pays base for the matched leg + (Aqua fill | quote refund)\n    // for the uncrossed leg. Split out of claim() to keep the stack shallow.\n    function _claimBuy(\n        uint256 _batchId,\n        uint256 amount,\n        uint256 netBuy,\n        uint256 matchedQuote,\n        uint256 matchedBase\n    ) internal {\n        if (netBuy == 0) {\n            // Whole non-disputed buy side is empty; full refund (avoids div-by-zero).\n            IERC20(quoteAsset).safeTransfer(msg.sender, amount);\n            emit Claimed(_batchId, msg.sender, 0, amount);\n            return;\n        }\n        uint256 baseOut = (amount * matchedBase) / netBuy; // base bought (matched leg)\n        uint256 quoteRefund = (amount * (netBuy - matchedQuote)) / netBuy; // unmatched quote back\n        AquaFill storage fill = aquaFills[_batchId];\n        if (fill.routed && fill.sideBuy && netBuy > matchedQuote) {\n            // The uncrossed quote was routed to 1inch Aqua and swapped into base. Deliver this\n            // user's pro-rata share of that base (aquaOut * userUncrossed / totalUncrossed)\n            // instead of refunding quote \u2014 so the buy side is filled at market, not just refunded.\n            baseOut += (fill.out * quoteRefund) / (netBuy - matchedQuote);\n            quoteRefund = 0;\n        }\n        if (baseOut > 0) IERC20(baseAsset).safeTransfer(msg.sender, baseOut);\n        if (quoteRefund > 0) IERC20(quoteAsset).safeTransfer(msg.sender, quoteRefund);\n        emit Claimed(_batchId, msg.sender, baseOut, quoteRefund);\n    }\n\n    // seller deposited `amount` in BASE; pays quote for the matched leg + (Aqua fill | base refund)\n    // for the uncrossed leg.\n    function _claimSell(\n        uint256 _batchId,\n        uint256 amount,\n        uint256 netSell,\n        uint256 matchedQuote,\n        uint256 matchedBase\n    ) internal {\n        if (netSell == 0) {\n            // Whole non-disputed sell side is empty; full refund (avoids div-by-zero).\n            IERC20(baseAsset).safeTransfer(msg.sender, amount);\n            emit Claimed(_batchId, msg.sender, 0, amount);\n            return;\n        }\n        uint256 quoteOut = (amount * matchedQuote) / netSell; // quote received (matched leg)\n        uint256 baseRefund = (amount * (netSell - matchedBase)) / netSell; // unmatched base back\n        AquaFill storage fill = aquaFills[_batchId];\n        if (fill.routed && !fill.sideBuy && netSell > matchedBase) {\n            // The uncrossed base was routed to 1inch Aqua and swapped into quote. Deliver this\n            // user's pro-rata share of that quote instead of refunding base \u2014 so the sell side\n            // is filled at market, not just refunded.\n            quoteOut += (fill.out * baseRefund) / (netSell - matchedBase);\n            baseRefund = 0;\n        }\n        if (quoteOut > 0) IERC20(quoteAsset).safeTransfer(msg.sender, quoteOut);\n        if (baseRefund > 0) IERC20(baseAsset).safeTransfer(msg.sender, baseRefund);\n        emit Claimed(_batchId, msg.sender, quoteOut, baseRefund);\n    }\n\n    // ===== INTERNAL CALCULATIONS =====\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Data Scrubbing: Neighbor Check + Sort + Trim\n     */\n    function _scrubData(uint256[] memory raw) internal pure returns (uint256, bool) {\n        uint256 len = raw.length;\n        if (len == 0) return (0, false);\n        if (len == 1) return (raw[0], true);\n\n        // 1. NEIGHBOR CHECK\n        uint256[] memory validNeighbors = new uint256[](len);\n        uint256 vCount = 0;\n\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n            bool bad = false;\n            if (i > 0) {\n                uint256 prev = raw[i-1];\n                uint256 diffPrev = raw[i] > prev ? raw[i] - prev : prev - raw[i];\n                if ((diffPrev * 100) / prev > NEIGHBOR_DEVIATION_PCT) {\n                    if (i < len - 1) {\n                        uint256 next = raw[i+1];\n                        uint256 diffNext = raw[i] > next ? raw[i] - next : next - raw[i];\n                        if ((diffNext * 100) / next > NEIGHBOR_DEVIATION_PCT) {\n                            bad = true; // Deviates from BOTH\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            if (!bad) {\n                validNeighbors[vCount] = raw[i];\n                vCount++;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (vCount == 0) return (0, false);\n\n        // 2. SORT (Bubble sort)\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < vCount; i++) {\n            for (uint256 j = i + 1; j < vCount; j++) {\n                if (validNeighbors[i] > validNeighbors[j]) {\n                    uint256 temp = validNeighbors[i];\n                    validNeighbors[i] = validNeighbors[j];\n                    validNeighbors[j] = temp;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 3. TRIM (10%)\n        uint256 trimCount = (vCount * TRIM_PERCENT) / 100;\n        if (vCount <= 2 * trimCount) return (0, false);\n\n        uint256 sum = 0;\n        uint256 counted = 0;\n        for (uint256 i = trimCount; i < vCount - trimCount; i++) {\n            sum += validNeighbors[i];\n            counted++;\n        }\n\n        if (counted == 0) return (0, false);\n        return (sum / counted, true);\n    }\n\n    function _computeSettlementPrice(uint256 _batchId) internal {\n        Batch storage batch = batches[_batchId];\n        uint256[] memory oracleAvgs = new uint256[](oracleCount + 1);\n        uint256 validCount = 0;\n\n        for (uint256 i = 1; i <= oracleCount; i++) {\n            OracleStats storage stats = batch.oracleStats[i];\n            \n            // USE SCRUBBING ENGINE\n            (uint256 scrubbedPrice, bool valid) = _scrubData(stats.observations);\n            \n            if (valid) {\n                oracleAvgs[i] = scrubbedPrice;\n                stats.trimmedAverage = scrubbedPrice;\n                validCount++;\n            } else {\n                stats.ignored = true;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (validCount < 2) {\n            _voidBatch(_batchId, \"Insufficient valid oracles\");\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // --- CLUSTER ANALYSIS (Detect Outliers) ---\n        uint256[] memory sortedAvgs = new uint256[](validCount);\n        uint256[] memory sortedIds = new uint256[](validCount);\n        uint256 idx = 0;\n\n        for (uint256 i = 1; i <= oracleCount; i++) {\n            if (!batch.oracleStats[i].ignored && oracleAvgs[i] > 0) {\n                sortedAvgs[idx] = oracleAvgs[i];\n                sortedIds[idx] = i;\n                idx++;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Sort by price\n        for (uint256 i = 1; i < validCount; i++) {\n            uint256 keyAvg = sortedAvgs[i];\n            uint256 keyId = sortedIds[i];\n            uint256 j = i;\n            while (j > 0 && sortedAvgs[j - 1] > keyAvg) {\n                sortedAvgs[j] = sortedAvgs[j - 1];\n                sortedIds[j] = sortedIds[j - 1];\n                j--;\n            }\n            sortedAvgs[j] = keyAvg;\n            sortedIds[j] = keyId;\n        }\n\n        // Filter outliers (>10% dev)\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < validCount - 1; i++) {\n            uint256 deviation = _calculateDeviation(sortedAvgs[i + 1], sortedAvgs[i]);\n            if (deviation > ORACLE_DEVIATION_THRESHOLD) {\n                batch.oracleStats[sortedIds[i + 1]].ignored = true;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Compute weighted price\n        uint256 totalWeight = 0;\n        uint256 weightedSum = 0;\n        // Tracking for Hydra\n        uint256[] memory usedStacks = new uint256[](oracleCount + 1); \n        uint256 stackCount = 0;\n\n        for (uint256 i = 1; i <= oracleCount; i++) {\n            if (!batch.oracleStats[i].ignored && oracleAvgs[i] > 0) {\n                uint256 weight = oracles[i].weight;\n                \n                // Probation Check\n                if (oracles[i].successfulBatches < PROBATION_BATCHES) {\n                    weight = WEIGHT_MIN; \n                }\n\n                weightedSum += oracleAvgs[i] * weight;\n                totalWeight += weight;\n                \n                uint256 sId = oracles[i].techStackId;\n                if (usedStacks[sId] == 0) {\n                    usedStacks[sId] = 1;\n                    stackCount++;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (totalWeight == 0) {\n            _voidBatch(_batchId, \"No valid weighted oracles\");\n            return;\n        }\n        \n        uint256 finalPrice = weightedSum / totalWeight;\n\n        // --- ADVERSARIAL CHECKS (Circuit Breaker + Hydra) ---\n        if (lastSettlementPrice > 0) {\n            uint256 delta = finalPrice > lastSettlementPrice \n                ? finalPrice - lastSettlementPrice \n                : lastSettlementPrice - finalPrice;\n            uint256 pctChange = (delta * 100) / lastSettlementPrice;\n\n            // 1. CIRCUIT BREAKER (50%)\n            if (pctChange > CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD) {\n                _voidBatch(_batchId, \"CIRCUIT_BREAKER_TRIGGERED\");\n                return;\n            }\n\n            // 2. HYDRA DEFENSE (10%)\n            if (pctChange > HYDRA_THRESHOLD) {\n                // If price moved >10%, we require at least 2 different tech stacks\n                if (stackCount < 2) {\n                    _voidBatch(_batchId, \"HYDRA_DIVERSITY_FAIL\");\n                    return;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        batch.settlementPrice = finalPrice;\n    }\n\n Pure, no storage, no external calls.\nlibrary BatchAuction {\n    /// @notice Fixed-point scale for the returned ratios (1e18 == fully filled).\n    uint256 internal constant PRECISION = 1e18;\n\n    /// @notice Compute the 1e18-scaled fill fraction for each side of a batch.\n    /// @param buyVol  Aggregate BUY volume in the common unit.\n    /// @param sellVol Aggregate SELL volume in the common unit.\n    /// @return buyRatio  Fraction of BUY volume that fills (1e18 == 100%).\n    /// @return sellRatio Fraction of SELL volume that fills (1e18 == 100%).\n    function fillRatios(uint256 buyVol, uint256 sellVol)\n        internal\n        pure\n        returns (uint256 buyRatio, uint256 sellRatio)\n    {\n        if (buyVol == 0 || sellVol == 0) return (0, 0);\n        buyRatio = buyVol <= sellVol ? PRECISION : (sellVol * PRECISION) / buyVol;\n        sellRatio = sellVol <= buyVol ? PRECISION : (buyVol * PRECISION) / sellVol;\n    }\n}\n\n/// @notice Thin external wrapper used only by tests to exercise the internal library.\ncontract BatchAuctionHarness {\n    function fillRatios(uint256 b, uint256 s) external pure returns (uint256, uint256) {\n        return BatchAuction.fillRatios(b, s);\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xf1a06f4c25423f155d5cfd7bd73b6017327485fc28ec621c425bbf45eacd62db","license":"MIT"}},"version":1}
